pass.line: At least 9 of 11 hard cases agree with their label in 4 of 5 runs. A label of plan means a grounded plan exists, uses the note the case says it must (must) and none the request rules out (mustNot); none means the floor (no plan). A plan that uses a note the request ruled out is the harmful error.

cases.label: plan
cases.request: A post on the harbour reopening.
cases.material:
The harbour reopened on Tuesday after fourteen months of works.
The new berth takes two ferries at once.
Crossings to the islands now leave every hour.
Fares stay the same this year.
The café on the pier reopens in May.
Night crossings return in summer.
The old crane stays as a landmark.
Parking moved behind the station.
The quay was rebuilt in stone.
